text: Each session runs 'bash tools/coord.sh whoami acct-<first 6 of sha1 of the account email>'. That's a one-way tag, because the repo is public and must not hold emails. To map tags to emails yourself: run 'printf %s you@example.com | sha1sum | cut -c1-6' for each of your 3 emails (use the exact email, lowercase) and note which tag is which. The board then shows e.g. acct-7542bf, and you know it's that account. If you want friendly names on the board (A/B/C, no emails), tell me and I'll add a label map for the next session to build; the 'acct-unknown' you saw means a session never ran whoami (queued as TCL86c: make session start do it automatically).
